user_entra_identity_uidx.name: user_entra_identity_uidx
user_entra_identity_uidx.where: "user"."entra_tenant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user"."entra_object_id" IS NOT NULL

backup_jobs_copy_shares_ck.name: backup_jobs_copy_shares_ck
backup_jobs_copy_shares_ck.value: CASE WHEN "backup_jobs"."kind"::text = 'copy' THEN "backup_jobs"."source_file_share_id" IS NOT NULL AND "backup_jobs"."target_file_share_id" IS NOT NULL ELSE "backup_jobs"."source_file_share_id" IS NULL AND "backup_jobs"."target_file_share_id" IS NULL END

endpoint_runs_suspicion_idx.name: endpoint_runs_suspicion_idx
endpoint_runs_suspicion_idx.where: "endpoint_runs"."kind" = 'backup' AND "endpoint_runs"."status" IN ('succeeded', 'partial') AND "endpoint_runs"."snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL AND "endpoint_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

file_share_runs_suspicion_idx.name: file_share_runs_suspicion_idx
file_share_runs_suspicion_idx.where: "file_share_runs"."kind" = 'backup' AND "file_share_runs"."status" IN ('succeeded', 'warning') AND "file_share_runs"."snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL AND "file_share_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

jobs_suspicion_idx.name: jobs_suspicion_idx
jobs_suspicion_idx.where: "jobs"."queue" = 'backup' AND "jobs"."status" = 'completed' AND "jobs"."protected_object_id" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("jobs"."payload"->'result'->>'snapshotId') IS NOT NULL

pve_runs_suspicion_idx.name: pve_runs_suspicion_idx
pve_runs_suspicion_idx.where: "pve_runs"."kind" = 'backup' AND "pve_runs"."status" = 'succeeded' AND "pve_runs"."snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pve_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

report_rules_schedule_cadence_ck.name: report_rules_schedule_cadence_ck
report_rules_schedule_cadence_ck.value: "report_rules"."trigger" <> 'schedule' OR (("report_rules"."interval_minutes" IS NOT NULL) <> ("report_rules"."cron" IS NOT NULL))

schedules_interval_xor_cron_ck.name: schedules_interval_xor_cron_ck
schedules_interval_xor_cron_ck.value: ("schedules"."interval_minutes" IS NOT NULL) <> ("schedules"."cron" IS NOT NULL)
